project_name: DoCA Smart Grain Procurement & Queue Management Portal (PMFBY & e-NAM Inspired)
design_archetype: Government Official & Modern High-Density Dashboard Hybrid (Organic & Swiss High-Contrast)
target_audience: Farmers, Mandi Officers, Department of Consumer Affairs (DoCA) Officials, SIH Judges
theme: Light Theme Default (with High Contrast Govt Accessibility Toggle)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400

layout_and_grid.landing_hero: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Split: 7-col hero text + live statistics badge counter card, 5-col dynamic queue status simulation token)
layout_and_grid.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density Dashboard: 4-col key metrics top row, 8-col active token / queue status monitor, 4-col quick slot booking widget)
layout_and_grid.container_padding: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-12 for section containers, inner padding p-6 on cards to prevent border collision)
layout_and_grid.header_spec: Sticky Glassmorphism Header (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-emerald-100 z-50 with GOI Ashoka Pillar emblem graphic / text, scheme selector, language switcher, and Auth CTA button)
layout_and_grid.footer_spec: Dark Emerald Solid Canvas (bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-50 py-16 with official DoCA branding, emergency helpline 1800-FARM-HELP, and SIH 2026 submission credits)

key_components_structure.LandingPage: Hero section with official emblem header, scheme highlights, live counter ticker, interactive queue estimator widget, how-it-works scrollytelling steps, testimonials from farmers, FAQ accordion, and government contact details
key_components_structure.AuthModal: Phone number + password JWT auth with simulated SMS OTP verification flow
key_components_structure.FarmerDashboard: Slot booking interactive step-form, active queue live token tracker with animated position progress, procurement lot details, direct bank transfer payment status (DBT), and notification center
key_components_structure.SlotBookingModal: Calendar picker with real-time available time slots per procurement center with capacity gauge bar
key_components_structure.LiveQueueMonitor: Visual token counter with live estimated wait time, audio alert toggle, SMS notification indicator, and step-by-step mandi workflow
key_components_structure.OfficerDashboard: Procurement Center Manager console: token scanner/verifier, grain quality assay input, weight scale logging, instant DBT payment initiation trigger, and center analytics chart
key_components_structure.ProcurementCenterDirectory: Searchable & filterable directory of centers with real-time crowd level indicators (Low / Medium / High wait times)
key_components_structure.MultiLangSwitcher: Seamless English / Hindi / Regional language switcher toggle supporting instantly updated UI strings

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion staggered entrance for card grids and dynamic metrics
motion_and_interactions.queue_token_pulse: Live glowing pulse effect on current queue token number with live time countdown
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth hover scale (hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg) on interactive cards, active press state on buttons
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Full keyboard navigation support, high contrast indicators, data-testid attributes on all key controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React frontend with JS files (.js / .jsx) matching the backend FastAPI REST APIs.
Implement full end-to-end functionality for both Farmer Persona and Procurement Officer Persona.
Include live queue simulation using interval polling or state triggers so judges can test real-time queue position updates.
Ensure every input, button, card, status badge, and navigation item has explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='book-slot-btn').

Style the portal to look like an authentic Government of India platform (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana / e-NAM inspired) with crisp green accents, clean typography, Ashoka emblem badge styling, and multi-lingual EN/HI text support.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or modals — use solid or heavy backdrop-blur white surfaces.
Use Lucide React icons instead of raw emojis for a clean professional look.
